title: HiMu: Hierarchical Multimodal Frame Selection for Long Video Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2603.18558v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-form video question answering requires reasoning over extended temporal contexts, making frame selection a critical bottleneck for multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) bound by finite context windows. Within the controlled frame-budget regime that governs practical deployment, prior selectors score frames against a single global query embedding; as a result, compositional multimodal questions that involve temporal ordering or cross-modal cues such as "what happens on screen right after the narrator mentions the reaction?" are flattened into a representation that loses sub-event ordering and modality bindings. We introduce HiMu, a training-free framework for compositional multimodal frame selection. translated_title: HiMu：面向长视频问答的分层多模态帧选择方法
translated_abstract: 长视频问答需要对较长时间跨度的上下文进行推理，这使得帧选择成为受限于有限上下文窗口的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的关键瓶颈。在实际部署所遵循的受控帧预算机制下，现有的帧选择器仅针对单一全局查询嵌入对帧进行评分；因此，涉及时间顺序或跨模态线索的组合式多模态问题，例如“在旁白提到反应之后屏幕上发生了什么？”，会被压平成一种丢失子事件顺序和模态绑定关系的表示。我们提出了HiMu，一个无需训练的组合式多模态帧选择框架。仅需一次纯文本LLM调用，即可将查询分解为一棵层次化逻辑树，其叶节点为原子谓词，每个原子谓词被路由至覆盖视觉（CLIP、开放词汇检测、OCR）与音频（语音……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HiMu——一个无需训练的分层多模态帧选择框架，通过LLM将查询分解为层次化逻辑树并将原子谓词路由至视觉与音频轻量级专家，从而更好地处理长视频问答中涉及时间顺序和跨模态线索的组合式问题。
en_tdlr: HiMu is a training-free hierarchical multimodal frame selection framework that decomposes a query into a logic tree of atomic predicates routed to lightweight vision and audio experts, enabling more effective handling of compositional long-video QA questions involving temporal ordering and cross-modal cues.
